logentry-massrollback-execute:
{{doc-logentry|massrollback|execute}}

Parameters:
* $1 - the performer (with tool links)
* $2 - the performer's plain username
* $3 - the target user's user page
* $4 - number of pages rolled back
* $5 - comma-separated list of the rolled-back page titles
massrollback-linkoncontribs: Text of the link added to Special:Contributions' tool-links bar for users who can use Special:MassRollback.
massrollback-prompt-heading: Legend for the initial form on Special:MassRollback.
massrollback-prompt-submit: Submit button text for the initial form.
massrollback-form-username: Label for the target username field.
massrollback-form-start: Label for the start-of-range date field.
massrollback-form-end: Label for the end-of-range date field.
massrollback-error-bad-user: Shown when the entered username doesn't resolve to a real user.
massrollback-error-bad-dates: Shown when the date range is invalid (e.g. start after end).
massrollback-error-token: Shown when the confirmation step's edit token doesn't match.
massrollback-error-no-pages: Shown when confirming with no pages selected.
massrollback-error-too-many-pages: Shown when a confirm submission has more pages than $wgMassRollbackMaxPages allows. $1 is that limit.
massrollback-list-empty: Shown when the user has no rollback-eligible edits in the given range. $1 is the username.
massrollback-list-truncated: Shown above the list when it was capped by $wgMassRollbackMaxPages. $1 is that limit.
massrollback-list-heading: Heading above the confirmation checklist. $1 is the username, $2 is the number of pages found.
massrollback-confirm-button: Button text to confirm and perform the rollback.
massrollback-done: Success message after rolling back pages. $1 is the count, $2 is the username.
massrollback-failures: Heading above the list of pages that could not be rolled back. $1 is the count.
